checks.text: With no scans or encodes, the page shows the heading "QR Code Scanner", the text "No results yet", and two tabs labelled "Scan" and "Encode".

Clicking the "Encode" tab, typing "Hello" in the field labelled "Text", selecting "QR Code" in the select labelled "Format", and clicking the button "Generate" shows a preview image with the alt text "QR Code: Hello" and a button labelled "Download".
After generating a QR Code with text "Hello", clicking "Download" triggers a file download with the filename "qr-hello.png".

In the "Encode" tab, typing "123456789012" in the field labelled "Text", selecting "EAN-13" in the select labelled "Format", and clicking "Generate" shows a preview image with the alt text "EAN-13: 1234567890128" where the check digit 8 is computed from the input.
In the "Encode" tab, typing "ABC" in the field labelled "Text", selecting "Code 128" in the select labelled "Format", and clicking "Generate" shows a preview image with the alt text "Code 128: ABC".

In the "Scan" tab, clicking the button "Upload image" and selecting a file named "test-qr.png" that contains a QR code encoding "Test123" shows a result list item containing "Test123" and the text "QR Code".
After scanning a QR code that decodes to "Test123", clicking the button "Copy" on that result item copies "Test123" to the clipboard and shows a toast with the text "Copied to clipboard".
In the "Encode" tab, clicking "Generate" with an empty "Text" field shows the message "Enter text to encode" and does not show a preview image.
Reload keeps the generated QR Code with text "Hello": after reloading, the "Encode" tab still shows the preview image with alt text "QR Code: Hello" and the result list contains an item with "Hello".
